description: Response for a container resources update request
doc: Used by the device to report the status of updating container resource limits upon completion.

mappings.description: Request ID (UUID) associated with the update operation
mappings.doc: UUID matching the corresponding UpdateContainerResources request.

mappings.description: Success or error code for the resource update operation
mappings.doc: A 0 code indicates success, other values represent standard POSIX error codes.
Optional human-readable error details if the update operation failed.
